title: ScienceAI: An Agentic Harness for Scientific Literature Analysis
description: ScienceAI is an open-source agentic harness for scientific literature analysis. It coordinates frontier language models (GPT, Claude, Gemini) to extract structured data from research papers, perform systematic reviews, and replicate published findings with full provenance tracking. Three frontier models independently reproduced the primary findings of a published meta-analysis (Scolaro et al. 2014) using ScienceAI, demonstrating multi-model convergence in scientific data extraction.
